Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: CRESUM exercise-library Male technique candidate, one paired source sheet for two square app images.
Primary request: Create ONE polished original premium semi-realistic 3D illustration sheet of LYING STRAIGHT-BARBELL TRICEPS EXTENSION on a flat bench. Exactly TWO equal square panels side by side, landscape aspect ratio 2:1. LEFT shows the lowered, elbows-bent phase; RIGHT shows the completed elbow-extension phase. These must be different phases of the same repetition, not two starts.
Input images: Image 1 is the actual CRESUM Male Master identity, proportions, skin, hairstyle and blue-gray outfit authority. Image 2 is the frozen equipment MATERIAL/RENDER STYLE reference only: satin silver frame, dark matte upholstery, clean premium white studio. Do not draw its pull-up machine or borrow its kneeling pose.
Character in BOTH panels: same young adult clean-shaven brown-haired man, fit natural build, same face as Master, muted blue-gray short sleeve t-shirt, dark charcoal shorts, white ankle socks, light gray training shoes. Consistent natural skin and fabric texture; no blotches, waxy skin, oversaturated blue, patchwork colors or degraded hands.
Equipment: ONE identical flat exercise bench per panel with a dark matte charcoal rectangular padded top and a simple functional satin silver-gray frame with stable feet. ONE short STRAIGHT chrome barbell with a modest matching black round plate on each end, collars securing both plates. Same bar length, plate sizes, shaft and grip in both phases. No EZ curves, dumbbells, cables, machine, rack, extra bar or decorative parts.
Body/support: supine along the bench, head at LEFT and feet to RIGHT in both panels. Head, shoulder blades, upper back and pelvis supported. Knees naturally bent, both feet planted fully on floor. Calm neutral posture and modest natural lumbar curve, no raised hips or exaggerated arch.
View/composition: identical fixed slightly elevated three-quarter side view from the near side, sufficient visible bar span to clearly distinguish both separate hands and both forearms. Head-left/feet-right orientation, same bench/feet/head locations, subject scale, perspective, lighting and framing in both square panels. Use available square area generously while keeping ALL head, bar ends/plates, elbows, bench legs and both shoes fully inside each panel with small clean 4 percent edge clearance. Equal large character/equipment scale, no tiny subject in one phase. Clean white background, soft contact shadows, sharp continuous equipment edges. No center divider, typography, labels, arrows, muscle overlays, UI or watermark. The app adds phase labels separately.
MECHANICS — this is ELBOW EXTENSION, not a chest press or pullover:
Keep both upper arms nearly vertical to the floor with elbows approximately shoulder-width apart, in the SAME location in both phases. Shoulder position and upper-arm direction stay stable; only forearms rotate around elbows.
LEFT LOWERED PHASE: both elbows comfortably flexed about 90 degrees. Forearms incline toward the head; short straight bar is held just ABOVE the forehead with a plainly visible safe gap; no contact with face/hair/skull. Both upper arms remain upright and do not fall beside chest. Clear two-handed closed overhand/pronated grip, palms toward feet, thumbs wrapped around shaft. No bar behind neck, no bar on chest.
RIGHT EXTENDED PHASE: smoothly extend BOTH elbows until arms are nearly straight without hyperextension. Same upper-arm position; forearms align with upper arms so the bar sits above the face/head-upper-chest region. Same grip width and pronated hand orientation. This is the return along an elbow-centered arc, not a press with moving upper arms.
In both phases every hand physically encloses the straight shaft at plausible shoulder-width hand separation within the collars. Neutral aligned wrists, ordinary anatomical fingers/thumbs; two arms, two hands, no duplicated hands, fused digits, detached grips or forearm/plate intersections. Forehead clearance must be legible. Visible differences are elbow flexion and bar position ONLY; do not move body, bench or feet between panels.
Biomechanics grounding: CRESUM existing lying-barbell-triceps-extension ID, supine flat bench, closed pronated grip and neutral wrists, stable upper arms, elbow flexion/extension with head clearance. ACE exercise 36 rechecked 2026-10-30. Create original CRESUM imagery from these mechanics, not a copy of third-party photos. Triceps is the catalog Primary, no Secondary; do not paint any muscle highlights.
Output: exactly one clean 2:1 TWO-PANEL source sheet, LEFT bent elbows / RIGHT extended elbows.
